title: Majority of ground floor dwellings fronting a street or POS have direct access by terrace, balcony or courtyard
text: The majority of ground floor dwellings fronting onto a street or public open space have direct access by way of a private terrace, balcony or courtyard.
notes: 'Majority' = more than 50%. Facts proposed: dwellings.ground_floor_fronting_count (ground floor dwellings fronting a street or POS) and dwellings.ground_floor_fronting_direct_access_pct (share of those with direct access from the street or POS via their own terrace, balcony or courtyard). diverges: ch4p1 C3.6.2 requires every ground floor apartment (building.ground_floor_apartments_separate_entry).
